paragraphs.text: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be caused to stumble.
paragraphs.original: Ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἵνα μὴ σκανδαλισθῆτε.
paragraphs.translit: Tauta lelalēka hymin hina mē skandalisthēte.

paragraphs.text: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the hour cometh, that whosoever killeth you shall think that he offereth service unto God.
paragraphs.original: ἀποσυναγώγους ποιήσουσιν ὑμᾶς· ἀλλʼ ἔρχεται ὥρα ἵνα πᾶς ὁ ἀποκτείνας ὑμᾶς δόξῃ λατρείαν προσφέρειν τῷ θεῷ.
paragraphs.translit: aposynagōgous poiēsousin hymas· allʼ erchetai hōra hina pas ho apokteinas hymas doxē latreian prospherein tō theō.

paragraphs.text: And these things will they do, because they have not known the Father, nor me.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ταῦτα ποιήσουσιν ὅτι οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τὸν πατέρα οὐδὲ ἐμέ.
paragraphs.translit: kai tauta poiēsousin hoti ouk egnōsan ton patera oude eme.

paragraphs.text: But these things have I spoken unto you, that when their hour is come, ye may remember them, how that I told you. And these things I said not unto you from the beginning, because I was with you.
paragraphs.original: ἀλλὰ ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἵνα ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἡ ὥρα αὐτῶν μνημονεύητε αὐτῶν ὅτι ἐγὼ εἶπον ὑμῖν. Ταῦτα δὲ ὑμῖν ἐξ ἀρχῆς οὐκ εἶπον, ὅτι μεθʼ ὑμῶν ἤμην.
paragraphs.translit: alla tauta lelalēka hymin hina hotan elthē hē hōra autōn mnēmoneuēte autōn hoti egō eipon hymin. Tauta de hymin ex archēs ouk eipon, hoti methʼ hymōn ēmēn.

paragraphs.text: But now I go unto him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?
paragraphs.original: νῦν δὲ ὑπάγω πρὸς τὸν πέμψαντά με καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐξ ὑμῶν ἐρωτᾷ με· Ποῦ ὑπάγεις;
paragraphs.translit: nyn de hypagō pros ton pempsanta me kai oudeis ex hymōn erōta me· Pou hypageis;

paragraphs.text: But because I have spoken these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.
paragraphs.original: ἀλλʼ ὅτι ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἡ λύπη πεπλήρωκεν ὑμῶν τὴν καρδίαν.
paragraphs.translit: allʼ hoti tauta lelalēka hymin hē lypē peplērōken hymōn tēn kardian.

paragraphs.text: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is expedient for you that I go away; for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I go, I will send him unto you.
paragraphs.original: ἀλλʼ ἐγὼ τὴν ἀλήθειαν λέγω ὑμῖν, συμφέρει ὑμῖν ἵνα ἐγὼ ἀπέλθω. ἐὰν γὰρ μὴ ἀπέλθω, ὁ παράκλητος οὐ μὴ ἔλθῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς· ἐὰν δὲ πορευθῶ, πέμψω αὐτὸν πρὸς ὑμᾶς.
paragraphs.translit: allʼ egō tēn alētheian legō hymin, sympherei hymin hina egō apelthō. ean gar mē apelthō, ho paraklētos ou mē elthē pros hymas· ean de poreuthō, pempsō auton pros hymas.

paragraphs.text: And he, when he is come, will convict the world in respect of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐλθὼν ἐκεῖνος ἐλέγξει τὸν κόσμον περὶ ἁμαρτίας καὶ περὶ δικαιοσύνης καὶ περὶ κρίσεως·
paragraphs.translit: kai elthōn ekeinos elenxei ton kosmon peri hamartias kai peri dikaiosynēs kai peri kriseōs·

paragraphs.text: of sin, because they believe not on me;
paragraphs.original: περὶ ἁμαρτίας μέν, ὅτι οὐ πιστεύουσιν εἰς ἐμέ·
paragraphs.translit: peri hamartias men, hoti ou pisteuousin eis eme·

paragraphs.text: of righteousness, because I go to the Father, and ye behold me no more;
paragraphs.original: περὶ δικαιοσύνης δέ, ὅτι πρὸς τὸν πατέρα ὑπάγω καὶ οὐκέτι θεωρεῖτέ με·
paragraphs.translit: peri dikaiosynēs de, hoti pros ton patera hypagō kai ouketi theōreite me·

paragraphs.text: of judgment, because the prince of this world hath been judged.
paragraphs.original: περὶ δὲ κρίσεως, ὅτι ὁ ἄρχων τοῦ κόσμου τούτου κέκριται.
paragraphs.translit: peri de kriseōs, hoti ho archōn tou kosmou toutou kekritai.

paragraphs.text: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.
paragraphs.original: Ἔτι πολλὰ ἔχω ὑμῖν λέγειν, ἀλλʼ οὐ δύνασθε βαστάζειν ἄρτι·
paragraphs.translit: Eti polla echō hymin legein, allʼ ou dynasthe bastazein arti·

paragraphs.text: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he shall guide you into all the truth: for he shall not speak from himself; but what things soever he shall hear, [these] shall he speak: and he shall declare unto you the things that are to come.
paragraphs.original: ὅταν δὲ ἔλθῃ ἐκεῖνος, τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας, ὁδηγήσει ὑμᾶς ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ πάσῃ, οὐ γὰρ λαλήσει ἀφʼ ἑαυτοῦ, ἀλλʼ ὅσα ἀκούσει λαλήσει, καὶ τὰ ἐρχόμενα ἀναγγελεῖ ὑμῖν.
paragraphs.translit: hotan de elthē ekeinos, to pneuma tēs alētheias, hodēgēsei hymas en tē alētheia pasē, ou gar lalēsei aphʼ heautou, allʼ hosa akousei lalēsei, kai ta erchomena anangelei hymin.

paragraphs.text: He shall glorify me: for he shall take of mine, and shall declare [it] unto you.
paragraphs.original: ἐκεῖνος ἐμὲ δοξάσει, ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ ἐμοῦ λήμψεται καὶ ἀναγγελεῖ ὑμῖν.
paragraphs.translit: ekeinos eme doxasei, hoti ek tou emou lēmpsetai kai anangelei hymin.

paragraphs.text: All things whatsoever the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he taketh of mine, and shall declare [it] unto you.
paragraphs.original: πάντα ὅσα ἔχει ὁ πατὴρ ἐμά ἐστιν· διὰ τοῦτο εἶπον ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ ἐμοῦ λαμβάνει καὶ ἀναγγελεῖ ὑμῖν.
paragraphs.translit: panta hosa echei ho patēr ema estin· dia touto eipon hoti ek tou emou lambanei kai anangelei hymin.

paragraphs.text: A little while, and ye behold me no more; and again a little while, and ye shall see me.
paragraphs.original: Μικρὸν καὶ οὐκέτι θεωρεῖτέ με, καὶ πάλιν μικρὸν καὶ ὄψεσθέ με.
paragraphs.translit: Mikron kai ouketi theōreite me, kai palin mikron kai opsesthe me.

paragraphs.text: [Some] of his disciples therefore said one to another, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye behold me not; and again a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?
paragraphs.original: εἶπαν οὖν ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ πρὸς ἀλλήλους· Τί ἐστιν τοῦτο ὃ λέγει ἡμῖν· Μικρὸν καὶ οὐ θεωρεῖτέ με, καὶ πάλιν μικρὸν καὶ ὄψεσθέ με; καί· Ὅτι ὑπάγω πρὸς τὸν πατέρα;
paragraphs.translit: eipan oun ek tōn mathētōn autou pros allēlous· Ti estin touto ho legei hēmin· Mikron kai ou theōreite me, kai palin mikron kai opsesthe me; kai· Hoti hypagō pros ton patera;

paragraphs.text: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? We know not what he saith.
paragraphs.original: ἔλεγον οὖν· Τί ἐστιν τοῦτο ὃ λέγει μικρόν; οὐκ οἴδαμεν τί λαλεῖ.
paragraphs.translit: elegon oun· Ti estin touto ho legei mikron; ouk oidamen ti lalei.

paragraphs.text: Jesus perceived that they were desirous to ask him, and he said unto them, Do ye inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, A little while, and ye behold me not, and again a little while, and ye shall see me?
paragraphs.original: ἔγνω Ἰησοῦς ὅτι ἤθελον αὐτὸν ἐρωτᾶν, καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Περὶ τούτου ζητεῖτε μετʼ ἀλλήλων ὅτι εἶπον· Μικρὸν καὶ οὐ θεωρεῖτέ με, καὶ πάλιν μικρὸν καὶ ὄψεσθέ με;
paragraphs.translit: egnō Iēsous hoti ēthelon auton erōtan, kai eipen autois· Peri toutou zēteite metʼ allēlōn hoti eipon· Mikron kai ou theōreite me, kai palin mikron kai opsesthe me;

paragraphs.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, that ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
paragraphs.original: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι κλαύσετε καὶ θρηνήσετε ὑμεῖς, ὁ δὲ κόσμος χαρήσεται· ὑμεῖς λυπηθήσεσθε, ἀλλʼ ἡ λύπη ὑμῶν εἰς χαρὰν γενήσεται.
paragraphs.translit: amēn amēn legō hymin hoti klausete kai thrēnēsete hymeis, ho de kosmos charēsetai· hymeis lypēthēsesthe, allʼ hē lypē hymōn eis charan genēsetai.

paragraphs.text: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but when she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for the joy that a man is born into the world.
paragraphs.original: ἡ γυνὴ ὅταν τίκτῃ λύπην ἔχει, ὅτι ἦλθεν ἡ ὥρα αὐτῆς· ὅταν δὲ γεννήσῃ τὸ παιδίον, οὐκέτι μνημονεύει τῆς θλίψεως διὰ τὴν χαρὰν ὅτι ἐγεννήθη ἄνθρωπος εἰς τὸν κόσμον.
paragraphs.translit: hē gynē hotan tiktē lypēn echei, hoti ēlthen hē hōra autēs· hotan de gennēsē to paidion, ouketi mnēmoneuei tēs thlipseōs dia tēn charan hoti egennēthē anthrōpos eis ton kosmon.

paragraphs.text: And ye therefore now have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no one taketh away from you.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὑμεῖς οὖν νῦν μὲν λύπην ἔχετε· πάλιν δὲ ὄψομαι ὑμᾶς, καὶ χαρήσεται ὑμῶν ἡ καρδία, καὶ τὴν χαρὰν ὑμῶν οὐδεὶς αἴρει ἀφʼ ὑμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: kai hymeis oun nyn men lypēn echete· palin de opsomai hymas, kai charēsetai hymōn hē kardia, kai tēn charan hymōn oudeis airei aphʼ hymōn.

paragraphs.text: And in that day ye shall ask me no question. Verily, verily, I say unto you, if ye shall ask anything of the Father, he will give it you in my name.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐμὲ οὐκ ἐρωτήσετε οὐδέν· ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἄν τι αἰτήσητε τὸν πατέρα δώσει ὑμῖν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου.
paragraphs.translit: kai en ekeinē tē hēmera eme ouk erōtēsete ouden· amēn amēn legō hymin, an ti aitēsēte ton patera dōsei hymin en tō onomati mou.

paragraphs.text: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be made full.
paragraphs.original: ἕως ἄρτι οὐκ ᾐτήσατε οὐδὲν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου· αἰτεῖτε καὶ λήμψεσθε, ἵνα ἡ χαρὰ ὑμῶν ᾖ πεπληρωμένη.
paragraphs.translit: heōs arti ouk ētēsate ouden en tō onomati mou· aiteite kai lēmpsesthe, hina hē chara hymōn ē peplērōmenē.

paragraphs.text: These things have I spoken unto you in dark sayings: the hour cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in dark sayings, but shall tell you plainly of the Father.
paragraphs.original: Ταῦτα ἐν παροιμίαις λελάληκα ὑμῖν· ἔρχεται ὥρα ὅτε οὐκέτι ἐν παροιμίαις λαλήσω ὑμῖν ἀλλὰ παρρησίᾳ περὶ τοῦ πατρὸς ἀπαγγελῶ ὑμῖν.
paragraphs.translit: Tauta en paroimiais lelalēka hymin· erchetai hōra hote ouketi en paroimiais lalēsō hymin alla parrēsia peri tou patros apangelō hymin.

paragraphs.text: In that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you;
paragraphs.original: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου αἰτήσεσθε, καὶ οὐ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐρωτήσω τὸν πατέρα περὶ ὑμῶν·
paragraphs.translit: en ekeinē tē hēmera en tō onomati mou aitēsesthe, kai ou legō hymin hoti egō erōtēsō ton patera peri hymōn·

paragraphs.text: for the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came forth from the Father.
paragraphs.original: αὐτὸς γὰρ ὁ πατὴρ φιλεῖ ὑμᾶς, ὅτι ὑμεῖς ἐμὲ πεφιλήκατε καὶ πεπιστεύκατε ὅτι ἐγὼ παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐξῆλθον.
paragraphs.translit: autos gar ho patēr philei hymas, hoti hymeis eme pephilēkate kai pepisteukate hoti egō para tou theou exēlthon.

paragraphs.text: I came out from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go unto the Father.
paragraphs.original: ἐξῆλθον ἐκ τοῦ πατρὸς καὶ ἐλήλυθα εἰς τὸν κόσμον· πάλιν ἀφίημι τὸν κόσμον καὶ πορεύομαι πρὸς τὸν πατέρα.
paragraphs.translit: exēlthon ek tou patros kai elēlytha eis ton kosmon· palin aphiēmi ton kosmon kai poreuomai pros ton patera.

paragraphs.text: His disciples say, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no dark saying.
paragraphs.original: Λέγουσιν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ· Ἴδε νῦν ἐν παρρησίᾳ λαλεῖς, καὶ παροιμίαν οὐδεμίαν λέγεις.
paragraphs.translit: Legousin hoi mathētai autou· Ide nyn en parrēsia laleis, kai paroimian oudemian legeis.

paragraphs.text: Now know we that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.
paragraphs.original: νῦν οἴδαμεν ὅτι οἶδας πάντα καὶ οὐ χρείαν ἔχεις ἵνα τίς σε ἐρωτᾷ· ἐν τούτῳ πιστεύομεν ὅτι ἀπὸ θεοῦ ἐξῆλθες.
paragraphs.translit: nyn oidamen hoti oidas panta kai ou chreian echeis hina tis se erōta· en toutō pisteuomen hoti apo theou exēlthes.

paragraphs.text: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?
paragraphs.original: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς Ἰησοῦς· Ἄρτι πιστεύετε;
paragraphs.translit: apekrithē autois Iēsous· Arti pisteuete;

paragraphs.text: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and [yet] I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
paragraphs.original: ἰδοὺ ἔρχεται ὥρα καὶ ἐλήλυθεν ἵνα σκορπισθῆτε ἕκαστος εἰς τὰ ἴδια κἀμὲ μόνον ἀφῆτε· καὶ οὐκ εἰμὶ μόνος, ὅτι ὁ πατὴρ μετʼ ἐμοῦ ἐστιν.
paragraphs.translit: idou erchetai hōra kai elēlythen hina skorpisthēte hekastos eis ta idia kame monon aphēte· kai ouk eimi monos, hoti ho patēr metʼ emou estin.

paragraphs.text: These things have I spoken unto you, that in me ye may have peace. In the world ye have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
paragraphs.original: ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἵνα ἐν ἐμοὶ εἰρήνην ἔχητε· ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ θλῖψιν ἔχετε, ἀλλὰ θαρσεῖτε, ἐγὼ νενίκηκα τὸν κόσμον.
paragraphs.translit: tauta lelalēka hymin hina en emoi eirēnēn echēte· en tō kosmō thlipsin echete, alla tharseite, egō nenikēka ton kosmon.
